summary: Iteration 12: tested recipe new fields + compact list/modal + cost (spesa) block. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass (GET mikilab returns 18 recipes sorted by name with all new optional fields in schema, no _id leak; full POST/GET/PUT/DELETE cycle with dough_category='pre', water_temp_c=18.5, work_phases, extra_ingredients, base64 image_url and costing all persisted; PUT water_temp_c 18.5->20 saved without clobbering other fields; 404/422 error paths correct). Frontend (390x844): Mikilab tab shows compact list of 18 recipe rows (recipe-row-<id>); clicking opens modal (recipe-detail-<id>); asterisk improver-link switches modal to 'Miglioratore Naturale'; created a recipe through the UI dialog with dough category, water temp, photo attach, 2 work phases and costing -> saved, cost block (recipe-cost-<id>) VISIBLE with per-ingredient breakdown (Farina 1.20, Prefermento 0.40, Sale 0.01, Varie/forno 0.50), total 2.11, editable pieces (input + / -) and per-piece recomputing correctly (10 pcs -> 0.21, 5 pcs -> 0.42); edit re-open prefilled all new fields and PUT persisted water_temp 20; deleted test recipe (cleanup done). ONE functional gap: work_phases are saved but never rendered in the recipe modal.

ui_bugs.issue: work_phases ('Fasi di lavorazione') are saved by RecipeDialog and persist in the API/edit form, but RecipeDetail never renders them - the recipe modal shows no work-phases section (verified: modal text contained neither 'Autolisi' nor 'Puntata' for a recipe having both phases). Review request expected work phases visible in the modal.

issues: Radix console error on every dialog open: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' + missing aria-describedby - the recipe detail DialogContent has no DialogTitle/Description (a11y, noisy console).
Form uses native <select> for Origine / Tipologia di impasto / Forno instead of shadcn Select (inconsistent with the rest of the design system).

action_items: Render work_phases in RecipeDetail (e.g. a 'Fasi di lavorazione' block listing name · time · °C with data-testid recipe-phases-<id>) - currently saved data is invisible to the user.
Add a (optionally visually hidden) DialogTitle/DialogDescription to the recipe detail DialogContent in RecipeList.jsx to remove the Radix a11y console errors.
Duplicate key in /app/frontend/src/i18n/translations.js: 'cost_pieces' is defined twice in both it and de blocks (line ~109 and ~114 / ~578 and ~583); the later value wins - remove the dead one.
critical_code_review_comments: RecipeList.jsx (425 lines) mixes list, detail, cost logic; RecipeDetail (~170 lines) would be better in its own file, and the cost computation duplicates the same formula already in RecipeDialog.jsx (prodCost) - extract a shared computeCosting() helper to avoid drift.
RecipeDetail's cost block only shows when total > 0; a recipe with costing where all unit prices are 0 silently hides the spesa block (acceptable, but no empty-state message).

Cost block scales with the ingredient 'Riscala' factor but 'pieces' is not persisted when changed in the modal (local state only) - confirm this is intended, otherwise the edited pieces value is lost on close.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_QA Iter12 Costi (mikilab, via UI) and TEST_Iter12 Nuovi Campi (personal, via API). No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend recipe CRUD with all new fields is fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_iter12_recipe_new_fields.py. Seeded mikilab recipes (18) all have costing=null and work_phases=null, so create a recipe through the UI dialog (costing defaults to STANDARD_PRICES) to exercise the cost block. IntroGuide modal blocks the first interaction: click [data-testid=intro-close-btn] before anything else. Only remaining known defect: work_phases not rendered in the recipe detail modal.
rca_of_the_issue: work_phases: RecipeDialog builds payload.work_phases and the backend stores/returns it (verified by API test and by the edit form prefilling 'Autolisi'), but RecipeList.jsx RecipeDetail has no JSX branch for r.work_phases (only badges, ingredient rows, procedure, notes and the cost block), so the data is never displayed.
